title: ClipDesigner 1.0 beta 4
summary: ClipCraft is now ClipDesigner. Same app, new name: this release installs as ClipDesigner, replaces ClipCraft beta 3 and brings your Library and settings with it.

New name: The app, installer, Start menu entry, window titles and file types are now called ClipDesigner. The program is ClipDesigner.exe.
The MSI upgrades ClipCraft beta 3 in place: it removes the ClipCraft installation, shortcut and file registrations and installs ClipDesigner under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ClipDesigner.
Your data: On first start, your Library, recordings, preferences, styles and presets move from %LOCALAPPDATA%\ClipCraft to %LOCALAPPDATA%\ClipDesigner. Nothing already in the new folder is overwritten.
Exit ClipCraft before installing. Anything still in use is moved the next time ClipDesigner starts.
Portable copies: run the included register-project-files.ps1 to replace ClipCraft file registrations for .iclip and .vclip.

limitations: Unsigned Windows 10/11 x64 beta. Old development project formats are unsupported; back up work before updating.

Automatic detection and tracking of sensitive information does not guarantee complete coverage. Review every flagged range and the whole video before sharing. Focus and Magnify are emphasis, not privacy tools; blur and pixelation may leave information inferable.
Framed crossfades involving rotation, transparency or different frames can preview less smoothly than they export.
Scrolling capture is Region-only. By website fills in only when the window title names the site.
Silent startup on some older Windows 11 laptops is still being investigated.
PDF text is outlined, not searchable. No automatic updater.
If Windows asks which app should open .iclip or .vclip files after the upgrade, choose ClipDesigner.
